title: Asymptotics of nonlocal nonlinear Robin energies
summary: We study the free minimization problem for a nonlinear, nonlocal functional associated with Robin-type nonlocal exterior conditions depending on a positive parameter $α$. We prove that, for every $α>0$, the minimizer exists, is unique, and satisfies suitable decay properties at infinity. We also investigate the regularity of the maps $α\mapsto u_α$ and $α\mapsto E_α$, where~$u_α$ denotes the minimizer and $E_α$ the corresponding energy.
